status: pre-registered ProAR-inspired anti-drift mechanism pilot; validation-only invariant proxy, not an official competition score
hypothesis: alternating interpolation and endpoint forecasting reduces long-horizon accumulation error relative to one-pass block forecasting when both use the same trained networks

source.paper: ProAR: Probabilistic Autoregressive Modeling for Molecular Dynamics, AAAI 2026
source.adaptation_boundary: tests only the dual-stage training and alternating anti-drift sampler; omits Gaussian covariance, stochastic sampling, atomistic geometry and Amber relaxation

data.representation: 12-dimensional rigid-motion-invariant ligand trajectory features standardized with train statistics

model.interpolator: linear bridge plus learned residual conditioned on start, proposed endpoint, relative step and horizon
model.forecaster: endpoint residual predictor conditioned on intermediate state, block start, relative step and horizon

training.checkpoint_policy: final epoch; no validation checkpoint selection
training.forecaster_protocol: freeze interpolator, train j uniformly from 0 through h-1; j=0 input is the block start

causal_comparison.control: one-pass: forecast endpoint once, then interpolate all interior states
causal_comparison.candidate: alternating: forecast endpoint, alternate I/F for j=1..h-1, then recompute interior states from the refined endpoint
causal_comparison.shared: same weights, start states, block size, training updates and validation examples
causal_comparison.primary: unweighted macro mean of T1/T2/T3 standardized RMSE; official scenario weights are not currently published

promotion.paired_seed_wins: candidate macro RMSE lower than control in at least 2/3 seeds
promotion.mean_macro: candidate mean macro RMSE lower than control
promotion.long_horizon: candidate mean T3 RMSE improves by at least 5%
promotion.short_horizon_guard: candidate mean T1 RMSE does not regress by more than 2%
promotion.numerical_guard: all generated values finite and every scenario RMSE below 10 standardized units
promotion.next_stage: only a passing mechanism is ported into the equivariant 3D NeuralMD/EST-style model

anti_tuning: after results are visible, do not change block horizon, model size, seeds or thresholds in this experimental family
